title: Finance Analyst
teaser: We are expanding our team: As a Finance Analyst, you will support the Global Virtual Sales & Engineering EMEA organisation, focusing on financial analysis and process optimisation. Key responsibilities include building forecasts and providing actionable insights. Ideal candidates have experience in financial controlling or business analysis within multinational environments.
description:
Meet The Team

You will be part of the GVSE EMEA Finance team with compliance mindset, all keen on contributing to the outstanding business and financial results, bringing about positive change by driving actionable insights and optimizing processes.
Your Impact

You will be part of the Finance Team supporting the Global Virtual Sales & Engineering EMEA organization with:

building up Opex and Headcount forecasts, forecast vs actuals analysis, driving towards best-in-class forecast accuracy

providing deeper-dive analysis on Opex cost drivers, trends and business partnering to support Sales Org Leadership team with decision-making

providing financial expertise in all business-related matters

playing active role in planning, budgeting and forecasting process

supporting weekly and monthly sales forecast process

driving business and financial analysis with the aim to provide actionable insights and operational excellence assuring compliant and effective use of resources

ensuring the operating environment adheres to defined corporate compliance and controls as well as Cisco wide company policies and ethical standards

Minimum Qualifications
 

BA in Economics/Finance

3-5 years of relevant experience in financial controlling, accounting or business analysis with big multinational companies.

You are an open-minded positive professional with great analytical & Excel skills capable to work independently taking responsibility for what you do and driving initiatives, implementing change where you see fit and necessary.

You are highly motivated financial professional who has a drive towards understanding complexity and being able to analyze it.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in cost management, cost forecasting and reporting, financial controlling

Experience in working with sales teams
